Kasol & Manali: Offbeat Himalayan Escape

Delhi — Manali — Atal Tunnel — Sissu — Solang Valley — Kullu — Kasol — Manikaran — Delhi

About This Trip

Escape to the heart of Himachal with Awara Banjara's 6-Day Offbeat Himalayan Escape. Traverse through the serene Parvati Valley in Kasol, explore the snow-capped high-altitude landscapes of Sissu via the iconic Atal Tunnel, indulge in thrilling adventure sports in Kullu, and soak in the soothing Manikaran Hot Springs. Designed for travelers seeking the perfect balance of adventure, culture, and relaxation with a vibrant community vibe.

Itinerary

Evening departure from Delhi by comfortable AC Volvo bus. Overnight journey through winding Himalayan roads under starlit skies.

Arrive in Manali, check-in to your stay, and explore local spots including Hadimba Temple, Jogini Waterfall hike, Mall Road, and Old Manali cafes.

Drive through the world-famous Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul Valley. Enjoy snowy vistas and head to Solang Valley for adventure activities.

Head towards Kullu Valley for thrilling white-water rafting, paragliding, and visiting local handloom factories.

Drive to Kasol, visit the famous Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara & Hot Springs, explore Kasol Market/cafes, and board the overnight Volvo back to Delhi.

Reach Delhi in the morning with unforgettable Himalayan memories.
